commit_message: Docs: record transport publisher missing-tree incident
pr_title: Docs: record transport publisher missing-tree incident
pr_body:
## Summary

Records the confirmed trusted transport publisher false-duplicate incident as INC-007 and updates the canonical automation protocol so repeated conflicts for fresh request IDs are checked against the exact observed transport head before more IDs are generated.

The incident records the production recovery after PR #76: the unchanged immutable r8 stage replay succeeded through publisher and Dispatcher, and a fresh r9 request also published successfully.

## Validation

Documentation-only change. No Rust or visual behavior is modified.
